<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ocean's Bite](/Feats.aspx?ID=5345) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 36

**Prerequisites**
[Abyssal Merfolk](/Heritages.aspx?ID=298) heritage or [Carcharodon Merfolk](/Heritages.aspx?ID=299) heritage

</column>

---

Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles. You gain a jaws [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the [brawling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=4) group.

prerequisite: Abyssal Merfolk heritage or Carcharodon Merfolk heritage
